query: INSERT INTO agent_team_rounds (team_id, round, started_at, token_budget, deadline_at, spent_tokens, ended_at, stop_reason, end_seq) SELECT id, round, created_at, token_budget, deadline_at, spent_tokens, COALESCE(ended_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), stop_reason, $2 FROM agent_teams WHERE id = $1 ON CONFLICT (team_id, round) DO UPDATE SET spent_tokens = EXCLUDED.spent_tokens, ended_at = EXCLUDED.ended_at, stop_reason = EXCLUDED.stop_reason, end_seq = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.end_seq, agent_team_rounds.end_seq)
